name: offer-desk.board-read
purpose: Read the ranked offer board once and report what changed against a caller-supplied baseline snapshot; absence of a baseline is reported, never treated as no change.

baseline.description: Prior snapshot as {"entries": {node_id: status}, "captured_at": rfc3339}. Omitted means no comparison is possible and changes_status reads no_baseline.

assumptions: Offer Desk is the team's single declared address for catalog, gate and posture state.
The caller retains the returned snapshot in its own continuity record and supplies it as the next run's baseline.
invariants: A missing baseline is reported as no_baseline; it is never reported as an unchanged board.
At most 80 entries are materialized; a larger board sets partial and says so.
An availability gap is copied from the board verbatim and is never recomputed.

signals.snapshot: node_id to status for every materialized entry; this is what the caller stores as the next baseline.
signals.changes: added, removed and status_changed lists; null when no baseline was supplied.
signals.status_counts: Count of entries per board status.
signals.actuals_gaps: Count and a bounded sample of entries whose actuals the board reports unreachable.
signals.default_alive_gap: The board's own posture text, or null when the response carried none.
signals.unknown_status: Entries whose status is outside the known vocabulary; drift, not a band.

fixtures.note: A malformed baseline is invalid_input, never partial.
Partial only when the board exceeds the materialize cap; changes_status reads no_baseline.
